ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side (a) is a block diagram of a closed-loop control system. The input is R(s), and after passing through a summing point with a “+” input and a lower “-” feedback input, it enters the forward transfer-function block; this block is labeled G(s)=100(s+1)/[s(s+5)(s+7)], the output is C(s), and the output is directly fed back to the lower end of the summing point, so it is unit negative feedback. The right side (b) is a graph of the input r(t) changing with time t. The vertical axis marks 20 and 10, and the horizontal axis marks 0, 10, and 20; the curve is a straight line sloping downward from r(t)=20 at t=0, and according to the slope in the figure it can be expressed as r(t)=20-2t. Reasoning: Decompose the input into a constant step term and a ramp term: r(t)=20-2t. The open-loop transfer function G(s)=100(s+1)/[s(s+5)(s+7)] contains one pole at the origin, so the system is a type 1 system. For a unit negative-feedback type 1 system, the steady-state error of the step-input part is 0. For the ramp-input part, use the velocity error constant Kv: Kv=lim_{s->0} sG(s)=lim_{s->0} 100(s+1)/[(s+5)(s+7)]=100/(5*7)=20/7. The ramp slope is -2, therefore the steady-state error e_ss=slope/Kv=-2/(20/7)=-0.7.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图(a)显示一个单位负反馈控制系统，输入为 R(s)，输出为 C(s)，反馈支路直接从输出返回到求和点的负端；前向通道中的传递函数标为 G(s)=100(s+1)/[s(s+5)(s+7)]。图(b)显示输入 r(t) 是一条随时间下降的直线，在 t=0 时取值约为 20，在 t=10 时降到 0，因此可表示为 r(t)=20-2t。

推理：由 r(t)=20-2t，拉普拉斯变换为 R(s)=20/s-2/s^2。单位负反馈系统的误差信号满足 E(s)=R(s)/(1+G(s))。稳态误差用终值定理：e_ss=lim_{s->0} sE(s)=lim_{s->0} sR(s)/(1+G(s))。代入 R(s) 得 e_ss=lim_{s->0} (20-2/s)/(1+G(s))。当 s->0 时，G(s)=100(s+1)/[s(s+5)(s+7)]≈100/[35s]=20/(7s)，所以 1+G(s) 的主导项为 20/(7s)。因此阶跃项 20 对应的误差趋于 0，斜坡项给出 e_ss=lim_{s->0} (-2/s)/(20/(7s))=-2*7/20=-0.7。
